info.name: PLATEChatter - ParkRelay Updates
info.description: Focused collection for the endpoints changed/added in this session: totalSpots on ParkingArea, the admin isActive pending-queue filter, ParkingArea enrichment on handoffs/saved-parking, and the new combined accept-and-park action. Use an admin JWT for admin-only requests, a releaser JWT for the user who leaves a spot, and a seeker JWT for the user who finds/claims it.

item.name: 1b. Admin - Create Parking Area (PAID, parkingFee required)

request.description: PAID parking area. parkingFee (per-hour cost, float) is now required whenever parkingCost is PAID - omitting it returns a 400, see the second response example below.

response.name: Admin - Create Parking Area (PAID, missing parkingFee) - 400

request.description: User drop-pin submission (matches the mobile Add Parking sheet: cost, electric charging toggle, disabled facility toggle + location). Always created inactive server-side regardless of body.

request.description: No spotId supplied - the service now falls back to the seeker's active SavedParkingLocation.spotId, so the resulting handoff (returned to the next searcher) is still linked to Green Park Mall.
Rating pop-up submission after exiting - unchanged endpoint, included here for the end-to-end flow.
